title: Marker Due
pitch: Julian Marsh signed a marker at Victor's card table. It's a month overdue and he wants to renegotiate. Don't let him.

clue_a.label: The fountain
lines: A chip from Victor's card room at the bottom of the fountain, dated Monday. Marsh has been back at the tables this week.

clue_b.label: The coupe by the house
lines: A signed offer on the passenger seat. Marsh is selling the car on Friday, for more than he owes Victor.
